# Shahariar Rabby

> Official website of Shahariar Rabby, Computer Science PhD and Research Scientist at the University of Alabama at Birmingham.

## Primary pages

- [Academic profile](https://rabby.dev/): research, publications, teaching, awards, and curriculum vitae.
- [Industry profile](https://rabby.dev/industry/): machine learning engineering, MLOps, and deployable AI systems.
- [Research](https://rabby.dev/research/): medical imaging AI, thin-structure segmentation, document understanding, and responsible AI.
- [Ekush dataset](https://rabby.dev/ekush/): Bangla handwritten character dataset for recognition research.

## Identity

Shahariar Rabby is a Computer Science PhD and Research Scientist whose work spans medical imaging, computer vision, document AI, and production machine learning.
